verdict.rationale: LanceDB's core is Apache-2.0 open source and embeddable, running on local storage, so a developer can prototype without paying. The evidence documents no hosted or cloud free tier, and no usage limits or upgrade path from free to paid. Missing for 10: a documented hosted/cloud free tier with stated limits, pricing-page evidence of the free-to-paid path, and independent corroboration of prototyping at no cost.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: LanceDB is one of the few options for embeddable vector databases, and I have used it in my Electron application.
run across local NVMe, EBS, EFS, and any object store that exposes an S3-compatible API
